name: Uryu Ishida
note: No build guide available on hideoutgacha.com at time of authoring. Tier/role/damage type sourced from the tier list.

skills.description: Uryu fires glowing arrows forward, striking 4 times and dealing 264% damage. Each strike of the basic attack grants 1/1/2/6 Battlefield Skill Energy on hit, respectively. While releasing the 4th strike, Uryu gains 1 stack of Quincy Mark.
skills.name: Blitz

skills.description: After aiming briefly, Uryu fires Reishi Convergence forward multiple times, dealing damage equal to 270% of ATK and gaining 1 stack of Quincy Mark. This technique grants up to 6 Battlefield Skill Energy on hit.
skills.name: Volley

skills.description: Uryu unleashes a barrage of Reishi Convergence on the area ahead, dealing AoE damage equal to 756% of ATK and gaining 1 stack of Quincy Mark.
skills.name: Licht Regen

skills.description: Uryu stomps on an enemy and launches himself backward, attacking up to 8 times in mid-air to deal total DMG equal to 540% ATK. While Uryu's Battlefield Skill is active, he accumulates 6 Battlefield Skill Energy when attacks hit.
skills.name: Counter

skills.description:
While active, Ishida's Battlefield Skill increases the whole team's damage of all types by 15%. Reishi Convergence: switches Ishida in immediately to fire a powerful spirit-energy arrow, consuming all current Battlefield Skill energy for 398% ATK damage. 
 
 𝑺𝒖𝒑𝒑𝒐𝒓𝒕 𝑺𝒉𝒐𝒕: switches Ishida in immediately to quickly fire at the target for 126% of ATK; this does not consume any accumulated Battlefield Skill energy. Reishi Convergence (field trigger): Ishida steps onto the field and unleashes a Combo Attack for up to 180% of ATK. After Ishida triggers Combo Attack twice or more in a row, the Battlefield Skill button activates; releasing the Battlefield Skill at that point does not consume Battlefield Skill energy.
skills.name: Reishi Convergence

skills.description: Use Hirenkyaku to avoid attacks right before they hit. Perfect Dodges inflict True Time Freeze for 1.5s and instantly restore 150 Ultimate Energy to Uryu. Cooldown: 15s.
skills.name: Hirenkyaku
